typography.currency_and_data: Use 'font-mono' (SF Mono) OR add 'tabular-nums' class to all numbers, amounts, and dates for vertical alignment.

colors.money_in: hsl(var(--primary)) or emerald-600 - Use for Revenue/Credit
colors.money_out: hsl(var(--destructive)) or red-600 - Use for Expenses/Debit

grids_and_layouts.base: Bento Grid Protocol (Mode B: High Density). Use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-5 gap-6.
grids_and_layouts.kpi_row: col-span-full grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-5 gap-4. 5 cards: Money In, Money Out, Net Cash Flow, Bills Pending, Untagged Alerts.
grids_and_layouts.charts_row: Monthly Trend Chart (col-span-1 md:col-span-3 lg:col-span-3) + Income/Expense Donut (col-span-1 md:col-span-2 lg:col-span-2).
grids_and_layouts.drilldown_section: col-span-full. Card containing the 3-level Expense breakdown.
grids_and_layouts.bottom_row: Bank Accounts (col-span-1 md:col-span-2 lg:col-span-2) + Top Vendors (col-span-1 md:col-span-2 lg:col-span-3)

component_guidelines.kpi_cards: Use 'metric-card' class (or flat bg-card with 1px border). Remove heavy shadows. Include a small sparkline or trend indicator (e.g., +12% vs last period) in emerald or red.
component_guidelines.drill_down_pattern: In-place view swapping using Framer Motion (AnimatePresence) or conditional rendering. Include a breadcrumb header (e.g., 'Expenses / Marketing / Ads') to navigate back up. Level 1: Horizontal Bar list + Donut. Level 2: Sub-category list. Level 3: Dense Transactions Table.
component_guidelines.period_switcher: Pill-shaped toggle (rounded-full bg-secondary p-1) with inner buttons (rounded-full) for active states. Options: FY, Qtr, Month, Custom.
component_guidelines.charts: Recharts AreaChart for Net Flow over time, or BarChart for In vs Out. Remove Y-axis lines, keep faint horizontal grid lines (strokeDasharray='3 3' stroke='hsl(var(--border))'). Tooltips must be Glassmorphism (bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/40).
component_guidelines.tables: Dense rows. text-sm. Right-align all currency columns. Use tabular-nums. Add subtle hover state (hover:bg-muted/50).

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use the existing '.glass' utility from index.css for sticky headers, tooltips, or floating action menus.
visual_enhancers.motion: Subtle layout transitions. Staggered fade-in for KPI cards (framer-motion). Drill-down views should slide left/right on transition.
visual_enhancers.icons: lucide-react. Use ArrowUpRight (Money In), ArrowDownRight (Money Out), AlertCircle (Untagged), Wallet (Net Flow).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over charts and colored badges meets APCA/WCAG standards. Do not rely on color alone (use +/- signs or up/down arrows).
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have focus:ring-2 focus:ring-ring focus:ring-offset-2.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements (drill-down rows, switcher tabs) MUST include data-testid attributes.

media_and_icons.instructions: No external images required. Rely heavily on typography, color-coded progress bars, and Recharts.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the dashboard inside the main content area (assuming sidebar exists). Add 'Dashboard' menu item in the navigation.
Use INR currency formatting (e.g., new Intl.NumberFormat('en-IN', { style: 'currency', currency: 'INR' }).format(value)).
Implement a robust 3-level drill down for expenses: Root Category -> Sub Category -> Transactions.
Add 'tabular-nums' to all monetary values to ensure alignment.
Use Recharts for the monthly trend chart and expense breakdown donuts.
Mock the data comprehensively to showcase the FY (April to March) periods, realistic expense categories (e.g., Logistics, Marketing, Office), and sub-categories.
Apply 'alerting-border' class to the 'Untagged Transactions' card if count > 0 to draw attention.
Do not use transparent backgrounds where content scrolls underneath. Use '.glass' utility.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic, centered 'AI slop' layouts. Use asymmetrical or heavily structured grid alignments.
Create depth using subtle borders and nested radii (e.g., child element radius <= parent radius).
Apply hover/active/focus states to ALL interactive elements. Ensure color contrast increases on interaction.
Never use generic AI emojis for icons; strictly use lucide-react.
Implement micro-animations for data mounting and view swapping.
